promotionGates.proposal: Documents only; no feature implementation implied
promotionGates.staging: Integrated actual provider/UI workflows and negative/security tests with reproducible receipts
promotionGates.productionValue: Real user-value workflows, stability, resource usage, accessible UX and owner-accepted verified deployment/production-grade operation
promotionGates.canonicalPromotion: Add only verified records to original manifest; retain all current entries, supply test evidence, independently validate Forever Works schema

scenarios.expectation: Bookmark import and instant save; preserved source provenance, optional annotations and durable pinned catalogs.
Independent titles, notes and tags on image, gallery, document, bookmark and relationship; authored reason remains intact.
Correct clickable 1 Gallery / 3 Documents / 2 Connections / 1 Video / 5 Files counts after filtering private children.
Local image plus R2 PDF selected as graph nodes and previewed top and bottom of right inspector while graph remains visible.
Permission revoked: local/R2 preview accurately denies operation and no credentials leak.
Graph time-vs-frequency sizing is deterministic; idle/background time not misrepresented as active dwell; missing data labelled.
Export through independently implemented AKF reader and roundtrip node, annotation, edge and media manifest identifiers.
Protected child of public parent remains invisible via links, graphs, counts, thumbnails, site bundle and JSON.
Compose an article using existing text/images with editable title, some bookmarks excluded and chosen references under relevant paragraphs.
Multiple publications from one catalog preserve source; test source snapshots and explicitly refreshed linked versions.
Generated static gallery/essay works without Atlas backend, has responsive keyboard support and contains only approved assets.
Stage integration and production-value acceptance evidenced BEFORE additive canonical manifest registration.
